ModMetaData.name: GateRim SG-1
ModMetaData.author: Diablood
ModMetaData.description:
GateRim SG-1 brings the Stargate SG-1 universe to RimWorld.
Current development scope: - Inheritable Jaffa lineage genes - Prim'ta Hediff prototype for an implanted immature symbiote - Goa'uld host xenotype prototype - Free Goa'uld symbiote pawn prototype - Recent Goa'uld implantation Hediff prototype - French translations for stabilized content - Player wiki maintained in parallel - Centralized colored C# logging scaffold - Windows build wrapper - Persistent Goa'uld symbiote identity data - Interactive forced Goa'uld implantation prototype - Automatic conversion into an active Goa'uld host state - Manual emergency extraction during recent implantation - Medical emergency Goa'uld extraction surgery - Autonomous free-symbiote pursuit and contact implantation - Controlled ritual Goa'uld implantation prototype - Explicit map target selection for ritual implantation - Timed core ritual ceremony with cancellation and save persistence - Core Goa'uld ritual basin environmental requirement - Optional Ideology integration, expanded ceremony requirements and host transfer planned next
Biotech is required for xenotype support. This is an early development version.
